Sets a listener setting that the scene sets when it is applied. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

```blitzbasic
Include "<audio.bb>"
AudioSceneListener underwater, BB_LISTENER_SPEEDOFSOUND, 1480
```
@param scene  A scene from [CreateAudioScene](CreateAudioScene). Anything else is a runtime error.
@param setting  `BB_LISTENER_ROLLOFF` (1, [ListenerRolloff](ListenerRolloff)), `BB_LISTENER_DOPPLER` (2, [ListenerDoppler](ListenerDoppler)), `BB_LISTENER_DISTANCE` (3, [ListenerDistance](ListenerDistance)), `BB_LISTENER_SPEEDOFSOUND` (4, [SpeedOfSound](SpeedOfSound)) or `BB_LISTENER_RADIUS` (5, [ListenerRadius](ListenerRadius)), from the shipped include file audio.bb. Anything else is a runtime error.
@param value  The value, with the same limits as the command of the setting.
